purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined civic center combining public assembly, municipal administration, service counters, records, and support infrastructure.
architectural_rules: The principal entrance must establish a clear civic axis from forecourt or street into a public lobby.
Public service counters and records access must be reachable without requiring entry into staff-only administration.
The council/hearing chamber must retain a recognizable public gallery and controlled staff/dais relationship.
Administrative and records areas must have coherent staff circulation and a plausible connection to service/support space.
Exterior massing and interior hierarchy must read as municipal civic architecture rather than generic commercial offices.

damage_doctrine.intent: Municipal center ruined by abandonment and localized structural failure while retaining civic hierarchy and public-function evidence.
